question: Who were awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2025?

options.text: Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi
Albert Einstein, Marie Curie, and James Watson
Robert Koch, Louis Pasteur, and Gregor Mendel
Alexander Fleming, Howard Florey, and Norman Heatley

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2025 was awarded to Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi__ for their discoveries concerning __peripheral immune tolerance__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The award was given by the Nobel Assembly at the Karolinska Institutet__.**
 
• **The Nobel Prize recognizes significant contributions in fields like __Medicine, Physics, Chemistry, Literature, Peace, and Economics__.**
 
• **The Nobel Prizes have been awarded since __1901__ as per the will of __Alfred Nobel__, a Swedish chemist and inventor.**
 
• **In 2023, the prize money for Nobel Laureates was around __11 million Swedish kronor__ (over 1 million US dollars).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nobel Prizes**__

 __
 
• The Nobel Prizes are one of the world’s most prestigious awards, recognizing exceptional contributions to humanity.
 
• The laureates receive a gold medal, a diploma__, and a __cash prize__.
 
 
 
• __**Peripheral Immune Tolerance**__
 
 
• The discoveries by Brunkow, Ramsdell, and Sakaguchi have significantly advanced our understanding of immune regulation and tolerance in the body.
